name: Publius Arma (Custos Armorum)
notes: Armory keeper. Holds half the armory keys (Rufus holds the other set). Heaviest armor in the unit: Lorica Segmentata (AC 17), Scutum (+2). Requires STR 15.
gm_notes: NPC Custos Armorum. The armory runs on his ledger and his keys. DC 13 Perception (in armory): he noticed the disturbed pilum rack and logged it but did not report it -- he is waiting to see if it matters. DC 15 Persuasion (him at Acquaintance+): he will confirm that two scuta were removed off-record. DC 17: he knows who removed them because the lock was not forced -- someone had a key. He has three names it could be. He will not say them without protection.
